description: This file defines API route handlers for managing user sessions in a backend service. It includes endpoints to list, create, retrieve (with messages), update, delete sessions, and post messages within a session, with integration to a Supabase backend and proper authentication and access control.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client instance using environment variables.

methods.name: list_sessions(user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all sessions for the current user, ordered by creation time.

methods.name: create_session(payload: SessionCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new user session based on the provided payload.

methods.name: get_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific session by ID along with its associated messages for the current user.

methods.name: update_session(session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update session metadata such as the title.

methods.name: delete_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a session.

methods.name: post_message(session_id: str, payload: MessageCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Allows posting a message to a specific session, validating ownership and that at least one file exists.
